title: The WHO seeks more details on the death of a plague research lab employee in Russia
content: The World Health Organization says it wants more information on what caused the death of an employee at a Russian plague research lab. Russia says the woman died of pneumonia of unknown origin.

title: What is the pneumonic plague?
content: The ancient disease of plague is back in the headlines after the death this month of a Russian lab worker.

title: This surprising mammal fossil is giving scientists something to chew on
content: It's likely you've already chewed and swallowed some tasty morsel today. But when did that ability emerge? New evidence points to at least the middle Jurassic, back when dinosaurs still reigned.

title: Judge orders that Christa Pike execution evidence be preserved
content: A week after the failed execution, Pike is awake but is said to be angry and confused. Her lawyers said Wednesday's hearing was about "transparency."

title: Trump approved the military's 1st firing squad execution since WWII. Why now?
content: The Pentagon says Nidal Hasan will be executed by firing squad in December at Fort Hood, where he killed 13 people in 2009. The announcement came days after a botched lethal injection in Tennessee.

title: Why Trump just loosened the rules on 'dyed diesel' — normally a farm fuel
content: Trump is temporarily allowing this fuel to be used on highways, although it's typically just for off-road farm and construction vehicles. Could that lower the price of diesel?

title: How Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has brought the culture wars to the military
content: The New York Times reporter Greg Jaffe says Hegseth has disproportionately blocked promotions of Black and women senior officers, and he's also been purging the military of transgender people.

title: She got Trump's $500 check for health insurance. To her, it's a 'political stunt'
content: As checks from President Trump for health costs hit millions of mailboxes, a poll shows Americans don't trust Republicans on healthcare. Experts doubt it will move the needle and say it is likely illegal.

title: Gut microbes followed migrating humans across continents, new study suggests
content: New research looks at the surprising similarities in the gut microbiomes of hunter-gathers in Tanzania and horticulturalists in Bolivia, and asks: What role do these bacteria play in human health?

title: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
content: The Lahore High Court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture and its main square is a pleasant spot shaded by banyan trees.
